receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from ''The Methodist Almanac' of 1861 (USA)
receipts.receiptText: Ginger Snap - Two cups molasses, one cup lard, one teaspoonful salt, one tablespoonful of ginger, three teaspoonfuls soda. Let these ingredients come to a boil; then add flour until stiff enough to roll out lioll out very thin, aod bake in a quick oven
